item.title: Coldest Night of the Year marks 10th year in C-K; raises $70,000
item.description: NeighbourLink Chatham-Kent celebrated its 10th year of holding a Coldest Night of the Year walk Saturday, which included hitting its $70,000 fundraising goal. About 150 people registered for the event, which began at the Grace Christian Reformed Church on Tweedsmuir Avenue West in Chatham, before participants headed out on either a five-kilometre or two-kilometre route. item.title: Trillium grant helps Linck buy new phone system, upgrade parking lot
item.description: A $39,400 Ontario Trillium Fund grant has been stretched by Linck Child, Youth and Family Supports to upgrade its communication system and improve its parking lot. item.title: May Court Club marks 90 years with donation
item.description: The May Court Club of Chatham celebrated its 90th anniversary by donating $20,000 to the Chatham-Kent Public Library recently. Part of the donation will be directed toward the Chatham branch’s children’s services to add a reading nook, interactive play wall, and a sort-and-stack story kit.
